lines.text: Solomon stands before the altar in front of all Israel, spreads out his hands toward heaven, and prays.
Solomon says God kept His promise to David, then says even the highest heavens cannot contain God or this temple.
Solomon asks God to keep His eyes open toward the temple and to hear from Zion when the people pray.

wrong_details.true: hear from heaven, His dwelling place

lines.text: Solomon asks God to answer a foreigner who prays toward the temple, so all peoples will know His name.
Solomon says God brought His people out of Egypt and set them apart as His inheritance, as He spoke through Samuel.
